description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 20.06.2022 to 26.06.2022
reasoning: This gazette notification establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges under the Customs Ordinance. It is a regulatory instrument issued by the Director General of Customs exercising powers vested under specific legislation (Section 17 of the Customs Ordinance). The content focuses on legal compliance requirements for customs payments and formally rescinds a previous notification, making it clearly a Legal/Regulatory matter rather than a government personnel, organizational, or other specialized category.
